name: St. Ignatius Church and College (Market St, 1855-1862)
shape_note: Footprint: OpenHistoricalMap https://www.openhistoricalmap.org/way/198835527 (CC0), 1007 m2. The Jesuits' first church and college on Market St between 4th and 5th (1855; a larger building 1862) before the move to Hayes St / Van Ness in 1880. Dates from OHM (photo source); heights not known.
